widgets.title: Emdeon transmit Finished

notes: no stream-label filter found in WHERE; emitted {service_name=~".+"} which scans all streams — add a label filter
FACET without LIMIT: NR returns the top 10 groups by default, the translated query returns ALL groups — wrap in topk(10, ...) if the cardinality is high
